# Priscilla Grant

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P23](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0023)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. She is also fair with golden features, seen dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant is lively and spirited. She possesses a playful nature, filling her time with mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full to the brim of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant was hired to teach at the [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school while her friend [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was living in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) on a springtime walk, where they discovered the forgotten garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) and spent the afternoon enjoying poetic conversations in the woods. Priscilla eventually visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) unexpectedly alongside Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) and the famous author Mrs.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became intimate friends while studying together at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their friendship continues into their teaching careers, with Priscilla taking a position at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) teaches in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The two share a love of nature, imaginative conversation, and leisure time together, often gathering with mutual friends for outings and hosting special guests.

- Friend of — intimate friends at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +5 more</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). During a visit to the area, Priscilla brings her aunt to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) can host the distinguished author for dinner and a walk around the local sights.

- Relative of — niece (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>
